Remark
[Large- and small-scale behavior of the lower bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0028 ↗ lem:chow-iii-ch17-mu-lower-lambda 1. ch17:17.7\group Entropy Bounds

The preceding estimate cannot extend to all sufficiently small $\tau $, since its right side tends to $+\infty $ as $\tau \downarrow 0$. If $\lambda (g)>0$, it does imply $\mu (g,\tau )\to +\infty $ as $\tau \to \infty $.
